en.text: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silent; A fire shall devour before Him, And it shall be very tempestuous all around Him.
en.title: Our God will not keep silent

es.text: Vendrá nuestro Dios, y no callará; Fuego consumirá delante de él, Y tempestad poderosa le rodeará.
es.title: Nuestro Dios no callará
